model_inversion_risk.description: Limited to output-based attacks; requires many queries to extract information

recommendations: Deploy prompt injection guardrails (input validation, output filtering) as highest priority. Consider a dedicated safety classifier layer before LLM inference.
Implement tool-call approval gates for all agent-invoked actions. Require human confirmation for any destructive or data-exfiltrating tool call.
Harden system prompt confidentiality: instruct model to refuse prompt-reveal requests, and consider system prompt encryption or separation from user-turn context.
